caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden statue of a standing woman adorned in colorful attire and elaborate accessories. The woman has medium-brown skin and black hair, and she wears a yellow dress with puffed sleeves, a red neckline, and gold trimming. Draped over her shoulder and hanging down her side is a blue cloth. She also wears a necklace with a round pendant. On her head is a headdress featuring three large, multicolored feathers primarily in shades of yellow, red, and green. In her right hand, she holds a bundle of cylindrical objects; in her left, she holds a rectangular box. The statue stands barefoot atop a rectangular base that imitates a cut section of wood. The background of the drawing is blank and cream-colored, with the figure alone centered on the page.
title: Cigar Store Indian
